how.heading: Find your fixer in three steps
how.intro: Search, compare, book. The shop quotes before any work starts, and the job closes with a warranty recorded against it.
how.step1Body: Filter by repair type, minimum rating, minimum warranty and service option — in-shop, home visit or pickup. Every predicate runs in the database, not on your device.
how.step2Body: Every listing shows a live opening-hours readout in the shop's own timezone. Not a stale table — the dot you see is accurate to the minute.
how.step3Body: Pick a slot and the shop accepts and quotes before touching your device. The job closes with a warranty window recorded against it.

why.heading: Built for the repair economy
why.localBody: Every shop is a real business with a real address — not a national chain or a remote call centre.
why.verifiedBody: Verified shops have had their address, phone number and opening hours confirmed by the FixGrid team.
why.liveBody: Opening hours are stored per-day, per-timezone and rendered in real time — not cached from last month.
why.repairBody: Every repair is an item that doesn't go to landfill. FixGrid exists because fixing things is worth doing.

join.heading: Run a repair business?
join.body: List your shop, set your hours and services, and earn 5% back on every bill you submit for completed work.
join.note: One-time listing fee · Refunded if we reject the listing
